We have displayCarStatus with option "fuel". That likely returns fuel status. Also estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage requires distance. We have distance 750 miles. So we can call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance 750. Also displayCarStatus with option "fuel" to get fuel level. Also maybe displayCarStatus with option "battery" if electric. But likely fuel. So call displayCarStatus for fuel. Then estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage.
